title: Why does lightning happen?
hook: Lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.

beats.narration: Lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
Inside a storm cloud, ice crystals and soft hail collide, separating electric charge.
When the imbalance grows, a faint stepped leader zigzags toward the ground.
It meets a streamer rising up, and a huge current flashes back up the channel.
That heats the air to around thirty thousand kelvin.
The air explodes outward. That shock wave is thunder.
Count from flash to thunder: every three seconds is about one kilometre.
